_readme: Copy this file to answers.json and fill it in. answers.json is git-ignored: it is the only place the codes exist outside Firestore.
One entry per gate. 'threshold' is the word on the landing page. Every other key is a room id from ROOM_ORDER in functions/src/config/game.ts.
answer: the code, as you would type it. It is normalised (uppercase, spaces and punctuation stripped, times kept as HH:MM) and stored only as a SHA-256 hash.
hints: exactly three, cheapest first. They cost 5, 10 and 20 minutes. The threshold has none.
evidence: the cards a solved room gives up. Each id is written to the player's file on success. 'reveal' is the text that replaces the redaction bar.
Then run: npm run seed:emulator   or   npm run seed:prod

hints: Second hint. Most of the working.

evidence.title: Time of death
evidence.body: What the detective now knows, in one line.
